## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 标准分区过滤（跨日查 2 天，用 timestamp 限制为当日事件）
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date >= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
  AND translog.timestamp < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(DATE'${grass_date}', 1), '${timezone}'), 'Asia/Singapore'))
  AND translog.timestamp >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(DATE'${grass_date}', '${timezone}'), 'Asia/Singapore'))

-- 按操作类型过滤
AND translog.operation IN (1, 11, 15)  -- click + impression + order
AND translog.operation IN (11)          -- CPM impression only
AND translog.operation IN (1, 15)       -- CPC click + CPS order only

-- 小时级查询 (seller_report_hi)
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date = '${BIZ_DT}'
  AND h = '${BIZ_H}'
```

```sql
LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(imp_cost_details) imp_cost_details pos2, imp_cost_detail
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql

SELECT deduct_unique_id, ads_id, SUM(cost) AS cost, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM cpm_deduction
GROUP BY deduct_unique_id, ads_id

SELECT grass_region, grass_date,
    COUNT(*) AS detail_rows
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(...) -- Presto 语法
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- 3. DWD 层事件计数
SIZE(imp_cost_details) AS deduct_imp_cnt  -- CPM 扣费次数
CASE WHEN translog.operation = 1 THEN 1 END AS deduct_click_cnt  -- CPC 扣费次数
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: dwd_advertise_translog_event_di (直接转化)

从 translog event 提取事件级明细，解析 decoded_extinfo 中的字段。

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW translog_event AS
SELECT
    translog.id AS id, translog.adsid AS ads_id, translog.itemid AS item_id,
    CAST(translog.shopid AS bigint) AS shop_id, translog.timestamp,
    translog.price, json_from_protobuf(get_json_object(to_json(translog), '$.extinfo')) AS decoded_extinfo,
    translog.status, translog.deduct_unique_id,
    root_ads_data_str, item_ads_data_str, shop_ads_data_str,
    imp_cost_details, cpm_event_details_str, ...
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live
LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(
    FROM_JSON(cpm_event_details_str, 'array<struct<user_id:bigint, entrance:int>>')
) t AS cpm_detail
WHERE grass_date >= DATE('${grass_date}') AND grass_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(translog.timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) >= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(translog.timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) < DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1);
```

### Snippet 2: dwd_advertise_performance_di CPM deduction (CPM 扣费展开)

将 translog_event 与 translog_tab JOIN，POSEXPLODE 展开 cpm_event_details 和 imp_cost_details。

```sql
SELECT ads_id, timestamp, shop_id, account_id, grass_region, deduct_unique_id, placement,
    cpm_detail.user_id, cpm_detail.entrance,
    imp_cost_detail.adjusted_cost AS cost,
    imp_cost_detail.credit_cost, imp_cost_detail.balance_cost, ...
FROM (
    SELECT translog_db.*, translog_event.*
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_shopee_ads_db__translog_tab_di__reg_s0_live AS translog_db
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT translog.deduct_unique_id, translog.adsid, ...
        FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live WHERE ...
    ) AS translog_event
    ON translog_db.deduct_unique_id = translog_event.deduct_unique_id AND translog_db.adsid = translog_event.adsid
)
LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(FROM_JSON(cpm_event_details_str, 'array<struct<...>>')) cpm_details pos1, cpm_detail
LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(imp_cost_details) imp_cost_details pos2, imp_cost_detail
WHERE pos1 = pos2;
```

### Snippet 3: dwd_advertiser_transaction_di (交易记录 CPM 入口)

提取 CPM 事件的 user_id 和 entrance 信息。

```sql
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT translog.deduct_unique_id, translog.adsid AS ads_id,
        cpm_detail.user_id, cpm_detail.entrance
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(FROM_JSON(cpm_event_details_str, 'array<struct<user_id:BIGINT,entrance:int>>')) t AS cpm_detail
    WHERE grass_region = '${upper_region}'
      AND grass_date >= DATE('${grass_date}') AND grass_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
      AND translog.timestamp < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(...)
      AND translog.timestamp >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(...)
      AND translog.operation = 11
) cpm ON translog.operation = 11
  AND translog.deduct_unique_id = cpm.deduct_unique_id AND translog.adsid = cpm.ads_id
```

### Snippet 4: dwd_advertiser_deduction_di (CPM 信用分摊)

将 imp_cost_detail 的 adjusted_cost 按比例分摊到各信用类型。

```sql
SELECT translog_tab.deduct_unique_id, translog_tab.adsid AS ads_id,
    translog_event.user_id, translog_event.entrance,
    ROUND((adjusted_cost * 1.000000 / total_cost) * deduction_amt, 5) AS deduction_amt, ...
FROM translog_tab
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT deduct_unique_id, adsid, imp_cost_detail.user_id, imp_cost_detail.adjusted_cost,
        cpm_detail.entrance, cpm_detail.sub_entrance, ...
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT translog.deduct_unique_id, translog.adsid, imp_cost_details, cpm_event_details_str, ...
        FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live WHERE ...
    )
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(FROM_JSON(cpm_event_details_str, '...')) cpm_details pos1, cpm_detail
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(imp_cost_details) imp_cost_details pos2, imp_cost_detail
    WHERE pos1 = pos2
) translog_event ON ...
```

### Snippet 5: seller_report_hi translog 数据源 (小时级)

直接从 translog_event 提取 extinfo 并计算扣费分项。

```sql
SELECT
    JSON_FROM_PROTOBUF(GET_JSON_OBJECT(TO_JSON(translog_src.translog), '$.extinfo')) AS extinfo,
    CASE WHEN translog_src.translog.operation IN (1, 15) THEN translog_src.translog.dai_after_balance - translog_src.translog.dai_before_balance ELSE 0 END AS expected_revenue,
    CASE WHEN translog_src.translog.operation = 1 THEN 1 END AS deduct_click_cnt,
    CASE WHEN translog_src.translog.operation = 11 THEN SIZE(translog_src.imp_cost_details) END AS deduct_imp_cnt,
    AGGREGATE(FILTER(entries_arr, x -> x.type = 1), BIGINT(0), (acc, x) -> acc + BIGINT(x.amount)) AS expense_paid_credit_without_expiry,
    ...
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live translog_src
LATERAL VIEW JSON_TUPLE(...) extinfo_parsed AS entrance, pricing_type, campaign_id, ...
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}') AND grass_date = '${BIZ_DT}' AND h = '${BIZ_H}'
  AND translog_src.translog.operation IN (1, 11, 15)
```

### Snippet 6: CPC/CPS deduction (点击/订单扣费 - buyer segments 解码)

```sql
SELECT translog.deduct_unique_id, translog.adsid,
    FROM_JSON(decode_func(base64(translog.extinfo)), 'struct<buyerSegments:array<binary>>') AS translog_event_decoded_extinfo,
    ...
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT *
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND grass_date >= DATE('${grass_date}') AND grass_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
      AND translog.operation IN (1, 15)
)
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

该表为 ODS 层外部表，数据由上游日志系统（Kafka/Flink）写入 HDFS，再通过 ADD PARTITION 加载。

| 属性 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| 写入方式 | 外部表 (HDFS 直写 + ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION) |
| Workflow 路径 | `data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse_us/ods/ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live/` |
| 上游数据源 | Kafka translog event 日志 (由实时系统写入 HDFS) |
| 分区策略 | `grass_region, grass_date, h` -- 按地区/日期/小时分区 |
| 清理策略 | DROP partition at grass_date - 7 days |
| 备注 | 存在 US 版本表 `ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live_us`（BR 区域），CREATE TABLE 相同 |

### 下游消费表

|--------|--------------|----------|
| `dwd_advertise_translog_event_di__reg_s0_live` | `data_warehouse/dwd/revenue/dwd_advertise_translog_event_di__reg_s0_live/` | 直接转化：LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE cpm_event_details_str |

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下派生指标在 2+ 个下游文件中重复出现：

| 指标名 | 计算公式 | 出现场景 |
|--------|----------|----------|
| total_cost | `dai_after_balance - dai_before_balance` | performance_di, deduction_di |
| expense_paid_credit_without_expiry | `AGGREGATE(FILTER(entries_arr, x -> x.type = 1), 0, ...)` 或 `paid_free_map[1]` | performance_di, seller_report_hi |
| expense_paid_credit_with_expiry | `AGGREGATE(FILTER(entries_arr, x -> x.type = 2), 0, ...)` 或 `paid_free_map[2]` | performance_di, seller_report_hi |
| expense_free_credit_without_expiry | `paid_free_map[3]` | performance_di, seller_report_hi |
| expense_free_credit_with_expiry | `paid_free_map[4]` | performance_di, seller_report_hi |
| deduct_imp_cnt | `SIZE(imp_cost_details)` | seller_report_hi |
| deduct_click_cnt | `CASE WHEN operation = 1 THEN 1 END` | seller_report_hi |
| expected_revenue | `dai_after_balance - dai_before_balance` (operation IN 1,15) | seller_report_hi |
| cpm_cost_per_user | `imp_cost_detail.adjusted_cost` (POSEXPLODE 后逐用户分摊) | performance_di, deduction_di |
